blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, QUEZON, Philippines — More than a thousand faculty members, employees and students of the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) staged a campus-wide walkout on Thursday to oppose the controversial Pax Silica initiative and to protest the anticipated visit of United States President Donald Trump for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit next week. Pax Silica is a US-led multinational coalition launched in December 2025 to secure global supply chains for artificial intelligence, semiconductors, and critical minerals.
